hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric for operational efficiency in railroads, reflecting the ability to control operating costs relative to revenues. Union Pacific targets a world-class operating ratio to create long-term shareholder value.

kpis.name: Operating Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of operating costs to revenues
kpis.description: Key performance indicator for railroads. Operating Ratio KPI tracked over 5 years, sourced from official financial pipeline.

kpis.name: Freight Car Velocity
kpis.explanation: Average distance traveled by freight cars per day
kpis.description: Key operational performance indicator for railroads

kpis.name: Terminal Dwell
kpis.explanation: Average waiting time for freight cars at yards or terminals
kpis.description: Key operational performance indicator for railroads

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Free cash flow after capital investments and dividends paid

kpis.name: Personal Injury Rate
kpis.explanation: Number of reported injuries per 200,000 hours worked
kpis.description: Key safety performance indicator for railroads

kpis.name: Derailment Incident Rate
kpis.explanation: Number of reported derailment incidents per million train miles
kpis.description: Key safety performance indicator for railroads

kpis.name: Intermodal Service Performance
kpis.description: Key operational performance indicator for railroads
kpis.signal: Stability and excellence in intermodal service performance

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.38 last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $3.236 billion last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 45.3% last year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years from filed 10-K reports.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $19.533 billion last year.

risks.title: Fluctuating demand and network capacity
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned first and described as potentially driving high costs and reduced operational performance. Language is repetitive and emphasizes material impact. The 'Industrial' category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Hazardous materials transportation
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in the document with strong language ('accident', 'combustion', 'loss exposure') and legal obligation to transport. Existential risk in case of major uninsured catastrophe.

risks.title: Escalating cyber threats
risks.score_rationale: Alarming language ('increased sophistication', 'zero-day', 'critical infrastructure'), mention of AI as amplifier. Risk considered inevitable and potentially paralyzing. Highly prioritized.

risks.title: Dependence on key suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Only two suppliers for locomotives, high barriers to entry. Explicit mention of shortage risks and cost increases. Direct operational impact.

risks.title: International business disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Linked to armed conflicts (Ukraine, Middle East) and trade policies. Repeated mention of spillover effects on customers and demand. Tense geopolitical context strengthens the risk.

risks.title: Strikes and labor relations
risks.score_rationale: Majority of workforce unionized, risk of strikes or lockouts. Emphatic language on operational and financial impact. Recurring risk in the railroad sector.

risks.title: Increased government regulation
risks.score_rationale: Explicit threat of new rules on pricing, capital, and tariffs. Mention of STB activity and 2025 rates. Risk of reduced profitability on investments.

risks.title: Extreme weather events
risks.score_rationale: Extensive network exposed to adverse weather. Mention of climate change as aggravating factor. Direct impact on operations and maintenance costs.

ai_positioning.summary: UNP does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
